name: 25696-decode1k-blockfp8-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1), sm90.
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1 -- one in-process vLLM engine, no collectives.
architecture: Dense Qwen3ForCausalLM, 36 layers, 32 query / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, hidden 4096, intermediate 12288, bf16 base; FP8 weights scaled per 128x128 block with dynamic activation scales, ~8.2 GiB in two shards. All of it reads off the checkpoint's own config.json.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=10, warmup the first 10% by completion, bounded at 1000 requests with a 1800 s safety cap, seed static 25696.
workload: guidellm synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix buckets: prompt exactly 1000 tokens and output exactly 100 (min = max on both, enforced with ignore_eos), greedy at temperature 0. The backend renders the prompt as a chat message and applies the template, so the engine's own prompt count reads somewhat above 1000.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant giving short answers to page-long prompts for ten concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# vLLM source checkout at 3d5f1c864051f3d8462537a1b108e51946e7c2a1
# (`git describe`: v0.11.0rc1-139-g3d5f1c864051) -- a commit, not a release wheel.

model: Qwen/Qwen3-8B-FP8
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
# Pinned, not left implicit: an engine built in-process resolves neither of these to a served
# deployment's values, so dropping them moves the operating point.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024
# The checkpoint declares 40960; the workload's worst case is ~1100 tokens.
max-model-len: 4096
